card.title: Which iPhones Will Boot With Top Board Only

source.title: Which iPhones Will Boot With Top Board Only

claims.statement: Booting a top board alone or with a non-original bottom board brings up 'Swipe To Recover'; enter the passcode twice and let 'Attempting data recovery' finish (NFC reconfiguration).

Top board alone: iPhone X Intel boots only to DFU (flash and retain data in 3uTools, or jumper S41 to S48); X Qualcomm and XS/XS Max boot without touch unless in a socket jig; 11/11 Pro and 12 series boot with touch given charge port (and power button on 11) flexes; 12 Pro Max shows a false temperature warning (10 kΩ to ground on pins 487/489 bypasses it).

iPhone 13 mini top board restarts (0x400) without bottom-board gyro pads 207/208/502/503/504/527/528; 13/13 Pro/13 Pro Max boot fine with prox and charge flexes; 14/14 Plus and 15/15 Plus need both layers to boot; 14 Pro/15 Pro boot but restart without the bottom board.

procedure: Connect required flexes (charge port, prox, power button as listed).
Boot top board alone or in an iSocket with a known-good bottom board.
Complete Swipe To Recover with the passcode.
card.caveats: 14 Pro power button value listed here as 0x10000 conflicts with 0x100000 on the 14 Pro restart page. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
